summary: Madison County tower, 80 ft with a diagonal staircase, administered by the Land Trust of North Alabama; the Register says it was moved from Redstone Arsenal, move date and condition unsourced.

visit.trail_note: Land Trust trail runs north from Riverview Drive SE to Green Mountain Road; the WAFF report gives 3.2 miles

events.note: Register records a site visit dated 11/27/21

evidence.supports: 80 feet tall with a diagonal staircase
evidence.quote: This tower is 80ft tall with diagonal staircase.
It was originally located on the Redstone Arsenal.

evidence.supports: administered by the Land Trust of North Alabama
trail runs north from Riverview Drive SE to Green Mountain Road
evidence.quote: The Green Mountain trail stretches north from Riverview Drive SE to Green Mountain Road.

evidence.supports: Land Trust created a new 3.2-mile trail on the mountain
evidence.quote: The Land Trust of North Alabama just created a new 3.2-mile trail on Green Mountain.

evidence.supports: work began in 2022 with 200 people smoothing the trail
evidence.quote: The project began in 2022, with 200 people coming together to smooth out the trail surface.

evidence.supports: Land Trust received a trail license from the property owners
evidence.quote: Land Trust received a trail license from the property owners to create this trail.

evidence.supports: owners have indicated they plan to donate the land to the Land Trust
evidence.quote: The owners have indicated they are going to donate the land to them in the future.

evidence.supports: the same report calls the path a three-mile path
evidence.quote: hikers will be able to see several neat nature sights on the three-mile path.

sources.title: Land Trust of North Alabama created a new trail on Green Mountain

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The WAFF report gives the new trail as 3.2 miles and later calls the path a three-mile path; the story reports both figures and does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: Register (read in full) and one WAFF news report from August 2024. The Redstone Arsenal origin rests only on the Register; a search for the move found nothing, and its results were a different Green Mountain Lookout in Washington State, excluded. No build date, date of the move, staffing, condition after 2021 or climbing rule is sourced. The record's 'standing' status is not stated on the NHLR page (the Register gives no status); it rests on the 2021 visit and the 2023 registration, not on a condition statement, and the story says so. Elevation 412 m matches the record. The four photos on the Register page were not inspected; the record's photos are all rights reserved.
